text: I approach the tavern runner. “Hot stew and rumors sound welcome—what happened to the missing patrol, and where can a wandering wizard find cheap shelter and honest work?”
motivation: Seek rumors and practical local information from a present NPC.
intended: Ask the tavern runner about the patrol, shelter, and work.

text: “Northwest of which crates, exactly—and who first found those footprints? Also, you missed my other questions: where can I sleep cheaply and find work?”
motivation: Clarify the patrol's trail while pressing for practical shelter and employment information.
intended: Get precise directions, identify a witness, and obtain leads on lodging and work.

text: I turn to the threadbare watcher. “You seem to notice what others miss—did you see the patrol leave, or anyone examining those footprints by the crates?”
motivation: Change interlocutors and seek firsthand observations from the watchful bystander.
intended: Learn who saw the patrol or investigated its trail.

text: “Then what has drawn your eye today—any face or movement around this gate that seemed out of place?”
motivation: Follow up on the watcher's stated attention to subtle faces and movements.
intended: Elicit useful rumors or observations about suspicious activity at the gate.

text: I keep my attention on the threadbare watcher and ask, “Who or what have you noticed behaving strangely at the gate today?”
motivation: Restate the follow-up with an explicit interlocutor.
intended: Learn about suspicious people or activity observed by the watcher.

text: I approach one of the weary gate guards. “I’m Galinor, a traveling wizard. Who commands the search for the missing patrol, and are they hiring capable help?”
motivation: Seek official information and possible paid work from a present guard.
intended: Identify the search leader and learn whether assisting the patrol search pays.

text: I go to the guard captain by the roster board. “Captain Thoran? Galinor, wandering wizard. I’d like paid work helping find your patrol—what do you know, and what would you require of me?”
motivation: Follow the guard's direction and directly offer magical assistance for work.
intended: Secure patrol-search employment and receive the mission's known facts and requirements.

text: “Reliable and discreet, understood.” I turn to the serjeant managing the crowd. “Captain Thoran sent me for official orders to aid the patrol search; what is my assignment, and what does it pay?”
motivation: Accept the captain's conditions and follow his referral to the serjeant.
intended: Obtain a concrete patrol-search assignment and agree on compensation.

text: “Before I scout, how many patrol members am I seeking, what do they look like, when were they due back, and where was their intended route?”
motivation: Gather essential identifying and route information before beginning the assigned search.
intended: Learn the patrol's size, appearance, timeline, and planned path.

text: I return to Captain Thoran. “Your serjeant says you hold the precise details: how many are missing, how can I recognize them, and what exact route were they ordered to follow?”
motivation: Follow the serjeant's referral and seek the restricted mission details from Captain Thoran.
intended: Obtain reliable identification and route information before scouting.
